description: Documented reusable procedures of a project (deploy, test, a code convention), with ordered steps. create, list (read), update (steps replaces the whole list; undo with manage_history), delete (undo restores it; with approvals on it waits for the user; refused for HTTP app keys and remote apps). A one-off choice is log_work kind=decision; a lesson is kind=learning. Requires project. Returns method rows.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

category.description: create / update: the group. list: filter.

code_example.description: create / update: sample code. No secrets.

description.description: create (required) / update: what the procedure is.

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.

name.description: create: name, unique in the project (required). update: a new name.

related_component_id.description: create / update: the component it belongs to.

steps.description: create / update: ordered steps. update replaces the whole list.

name: manage_methods
